<!-- One widget per pull request, please. The review check posts a summary of what it runs. -->

**Widget:** widgets/<you>/<name>/

- [ ] It's in `widgets/<my GitHub username, lowercase>/<name>/widget.owl`
- [ ] `meta` has a description, a version and a license
- [ ] Every package its commands need is in `requires { pacman: [...] }`
- [ ] Nothing personal: no tokens, personal paths or hard-coded location
- [ ] An update raises the version
- [ ] Optional: `preview.png` (a screenshot of the tile, under 300 KB)
